stories.title: AI ads are popular in the 2026 midterms, but state laws haven’t stopped a lack of disclosure
stories.simple_summary: Political campaigns are using AI to create ads for the 2026 elections, but there are no clear rules requiring them to tell voters that the ads were made by AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you see political ads online, you might not know whether a real person or a computer made them — which makes it harder to trust what you're seeing.

stories.title: Rice University launches AI master's degree
stories.simple_summary: Rice University is now offering a master's degree program focused on teaching AI — a two-year college program for people who want to become AI experts.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters if you're considering going back to school; otherwise it's not something that affects your daily life or business.

stories.title: Syracuse University launches artificial intelligence research institute
stories.simple_summary: Syracuse University created a research center dedicated to studying AI and how it works.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in the tech industry — it doesn't affect ordinary people or small businesses directly.

stories.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (a company that makes AI) promised to spend $11.6 billion over seven years buying computer power from Akamai, a company that runs servers.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows one big AI company is betting huge money on this technology, but it doesn't change what AI tools cost or do for you.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
stories.simple_summary: Actor Mark Wahlberg is speaking at a tech conference to talk about starting businesses and investing in companies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just news about a celebrity appearing at a conference — nothing that affects you or your business.

stories.title: Ahead of US IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible financing
stories.simple_summary: A British company building data centers (giant rooms full of computers) for AI work raised $3.36 billion in funding before selling shares to the public.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows money is flowing into AI infrastructure, but it doesn't change anything for everyday people.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse just stole the AI spotlight from OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) released a new personal AI assistant called Muse that is becoming more popular than rivals like OpenAI's ChatGPT.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's apps (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp), you may soon see this new AI assistant available to help you, similar to how a helpful robot might answer your questions.

stories.title: Opinion | A lesson from the Amish could help society cope with the future
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece suggests that the Amish approach to technology (choosing what to adopt and what to skip) offers lessons for how all of society should think about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a thoughtful essay, not news — it's arguing we should be more careful about which AI tools we actually need.

stories.title: Some Supabase customers are publicly exposing reams of people’s data to the web
stories.simple_summary: Some apps built quickly with AI are accidentally leaving people's private information visible on the internet because they weren't set up securely.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use newer apps or websites that say they're AI-powered, be cautious about what personal information you share with them — ask if they have good security.

stories.title: Astra and Opus just passed Turing’s other test
stories.simple_summary: Two new advanced AI models completed a famous code-breaking puzzle that a computer scientist named Alan Turing designed during World War II.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI researchers — it shows these AI systems are solving complex problems, but it doesn't affect what you do day to day.

stories.title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off
stories.simple_summary: Meta's Muse AI app is becoming very popular and Meta is promoting it heavily across its apps like Facebook and Instagram.
stories.why_it_matters: Meta is pushing this AI tool to billions of users — you may soon find it offered to you if you use Facebook or Instagram.

stories.title: Meta’s AI Tamagotchi bet is…working?
stories.simple_summary: Meta's personal AI assistant Muse (sometimes called an 'AI Tamagotchi' because you interact with it like a little digital pet) is surprisingly successful and popular.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows people enjoy using AI assistants as companions or helpers — similar products may become common in the apps you already use.
